text:
For an iPhone 17, the choice comes down to whether you want the **thinnest** pack (5,000 mAh) or **slim with full 25 W Qi2.2 speed** (10,000 mAh). The iPhone 17 supports 25 W wireless on Qi2.2 banks, while plain Qi2 banks charge it at 15 W. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html))

## Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)
- **0.34 in thick, 122 g (4.3 oz)**, Qi2 15 W wireless, 20 W USB-C in and out
- About **$54.99**, with a $5 off code applied automatically on Anker's site
- 9to5Mac called it the closest alternative to Apple's MagSafe battery and said it runs cooler than competitors. ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/))
- **Buy:** [Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim) at Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- Caveat: 5,000 mAh gives roughly 60–75% of a charge, not a full one.

## Best slim pick with 25 W and 10K capacity: INIU SnapGo Air 10K (Qi2.2)
- **0.5 in thick, 195 g**, 25 W Qi2.2 wireless, 45 W wired output, and a braided 60 W cable that attaches like a lanyard
- Macworld lists it as the "equal slimmest" 10K MagSafe bank. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html))
- Around **$42.99–$48.99 on Amazon** or $44.99 at INIU, which makes it the best value here. ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge))
- **Buy:** use the Amazon and INIU links in [Android Central's review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge). My search results didn't include a direct store URL.

## Other options worth knowing
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K):** 0.35 in, 119 g, Qi2 15 W, semi-solid-state battery, LED display, $49.99. ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge))
- **Baseus PicoGo Air AM71 (5K):** the thinnest and lightest here at **0.27 in and 104 g**, about $52.99 on Amazon. It only charges wirelessly at **7.5 W** (not Qi2 speed), so choose it only if thinness matters most. ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge))
- **Kuxiu S4 (10K):** ties the INIU as slimmest 10K, with 25 W wireless, a semi-solid-state battery, a kickstand and a display. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html))
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, Qi2.2 25 W, 45 W wired):** $59.99, reportedly $53.99 with code AM52 at Baseus's US store. The source doesn't list thickness, so I can't confirm it's slim. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)) That site is an affiliate deal page that earns a commission through its link: [dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w).

## Bottom line
- **Thinnest pack that still charges fast:** Anker Nano 5K Slim.
- **Most capacity and 25 W speed without much bulk:** INIU SnapGo Air 10K.

Use a thin MagSafe case. Anker warns that cases thicker than about 2.5 mm can impair the connection.
